steps.what: Establish wavelength, output or sensitivity, operating environment, interface and safety requirements for the laser, infrared or other optical device
Design gas lasers, solid-state lasers, infrared or other light-emitting or light-sensitive devices by choosing the optical architecture, materials and thermal approach
Set up resonator, propagation, detector-response or thermal cases appropriate to the device in the optical-engineering category of {OTHER}, reusing native geometry and parameter tables
Assess tolerance, thermal and optical results against actual test evidence where required, then write and check the final device design and limitations
Save the exact checked optical design snapshot in {DOCS}

tasks.design: Test native geometry and parameter reuse in the optical-engineering category of {OTHER}. Keep optical architecture, material choices and evidence-based validation human, then save the exact checked design snapshot.
tasks.previous_blocker: Related optical cases can require repeated geometry and parameter entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case structures can reuse explicit setup without choosing device physics.
tasks.still_hard: Thermal effects, tolerances and real material behaviour can invalidate an ideal optical design.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer judges whether a nominally correct optical model describes the actual device.

ambition.what: No new production or safety release authority.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated optical setup, unchanged engineering responsibility.

reach.learn: Trace alignment and calibration conditions to each measurement.

evidence.claim: Native optical case structures can reuse geometry and parameters without proving device suitability.

assumptions: Boundary is an optical-device design version, excluding production release and actual laser operation. Other-role testing is an input and earns no saving; any engineer test-evidence capture and review remain in s4.

The device owner supplies required wavelength, output or sensitivity and environment. The engineer verifies material, geometry, units, tolerances and source versions in s1-s3. Missing values require manual investigation, never unrelated variant defaults.
Native configuration first. Shares are illustrative and unmeasured; solver runtime earns no saving. Final s4 checking follows completed design and evidence note; edits void the save gate.
unknowns: Which native optical setup is already reused
research_questions: Which case-entry operations repeat without changing optical assumptions?

already_counted.description: Optical-case review and final design validation remain in s3-s4.

incremental.description: Maintain and revalidate optical case structures.

approvals.approved_version: Final device design and corresponding evidence checked in s4; edits require rechecking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Repeated case setup saves 6.25 gross hours less 1.5 upkeep for 4.75 net. Existing reuse gives zero gain. Architecture, evidence judgement and save retain effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Create and maintain photonic design histories

steps.what: Obtain actual photonic design revisions, requirement changes, test references and engineering decisions and resolve missing source material
Create or maintain the photonic design history's revision chronology and source links in the engineering document-control category of {OTHER}
Explain the actual rationale for optical material, geometry or interface changes and assess whether test evidence supports the recorded decisions
Assemble and check the completed photonic history in the engineering document-control category of {OTHER}, reusing revision and reference fields while checking rationale, omissions and exact versions
Commit the exact checked photonic history snapshot in the engineering document-control category of {OTHER}

tasks.design: Test native revision chronology and reference linking in the engineering document-control category of {OTHER}. The engineer supplies actual rationale, investigates missing evidence and checks the complete history before its versioned commit; no system invents why a design changed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Revision references can be manually gathered and repeated in a history document.
tasks.enabler_now: Native version metadata and links can assemble chronology and references deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: An orderly revision list can still omit the real reason or evidence for a decision.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer explains which optical trade-off actually drove the change.
tasks.altitude: Less chronology assembly, unchanged responsibility for the rationale.

reach.learn: Distinguish a version link from evidence supporting a decision.

evidence.claim: Native document-control metadata can generate revision chronologies and links, while rationale must come from actual engineering evidence.

assumptions: Boundary is maintaining the design history, not creating the underlying optical designs or tests. Existing design and test actions remain owned by their source tasks and are not counted twice here.

Design authors produce document ID, revision, date, changed item, requirement link and test reference. The engineer verifies and captures missing identifiers in s1 and authors rationale in s3; missing decisions require manual investigation. No complete structured rationale input is assumed.

Native configuration first. Shares are an illustrative manually assembled history, not a measured baseline. Final s4 checking follows completed chronology and rationale and binds exact source versions; edits void the commit gate.
unknowns: Whether native history and revision linking already work
research_questions: Which identifiers and chronologies are currently assembled more than once?

already_counted.description: Chronology review, rationale and final history checking remain in s2-s4.

incremental.description: Maintain history-field mappings and resolve broken source references.

approvals.approved_version: Completed photonic design history and linked source versions checked in s4; edits require rechecking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Chronology and repeated fields save 18.8 gross hours less 2 upkeep for 16.8 net. Existing native history gives zero benefit. Source investigation, rationale and commit remain counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review the applicable photonic build revision, process instructions and current manufacturing evidence
Oversee or provide expertise on photonic manufacturing, assembly or fabrication, inspecting alignment, materials and actual deviations and discussing them with technicians
Write and check the actual fabrication guidance and unresolved constraints in the existing {PROJECT} build item
Post the exact checked fabrication guidance in the existing {PROJECT} build item

tasks.design: Keep actual fabrication oversight and ordinary build-item guidance in the existing {PROJECT} workflow. Separating live expertise from writing and posting reveals no established duplicate entry or safe substitute for the engineering judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Expertise depends on the actual build, alignment and process conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing native build records already support capture; no additional saving mechanism is established.
tasks.still_hard: Subtle fabrication deviations need optical and manufacturing understanding.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer interprets a real assembly problem beyond its nominal instructions.

reach.learn: Relate alignment and contamination evidence to the build revision.

evidence.claim: Fabrication expertise depends on actual process conditions and cannot be replaced by a recorded nominal plan.

assumptions: Boundary is engineer oversight and ordinary guidance in an existing build item, excluding technicians' fabrication and formal production release. No new report baseline is invented.

Manufacturing records supply build ID, revision, current stage and actual deviations. The engineer reads them in s1, inspects and discusses real conditions in s2 and writes actual guidance in s3. Missing context is clarified manually, with capture counted.

Illustrative shares are unmeasured. Existing native entry is assumed and no duplicate capture is established. Ordinary final s3 checking binds the completed update; edits void the post gate. No new tool means zero upkeep.
unknowns: Whether actual guidance is entered directly in the native build item
research_questions: Is there confirmed duplicate guidance capture beyond the native item?

already_counted.description: Actual guidance writing and checking remain in s3.

incremental.description: No new tool or procedure; zero additional upkeep.

approvals.approved_version: Actual fabrication guidance completed and checked in s3; edits require rechecking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Build review, live expertise, actual written guidance and posting are separately counted and unchanged. No duplicate-entry or physical-work saving is established.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Verify incident spectrum, illumination, environmental conditions and intended energy output or device interface requirements
Design solar energy photonics or other energy-generating materials or devices, choosing optical absorption, material stack and conversion approach
Set up spectral, geometry and material-stack cases in the optical-device simulation category of {OTHER}, using native parameter sweeps and explicit units
Compare actual optical and conversion evidence with model results, assess losses and tolerances, and write and check the final energy-photonic design and limitations
Save the exact checked energy-photonic snapshot in {DOCS}

tasks.design: Test native spectral and material-stack sweeps in the optical-device simulation category of {OTHER}. The engineer still chooses the conversion architecture, checks evidence and actual losses and saves the final design with its limits; no unmeasured energy yield is promised.
tasks.previous_blocker: Related spectral and stack cases can repeat setup.
tasks.enabler_now: Native sweep tables can reuse explicit case structure.
tasks.still_hard: Absorption alone does not establish net conversion performance in the intended environment.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer distinguishes an optical model benefit from usable energy output.

ambition.what: No production release or energy-yield guarantee.

tasks.altitude: Less sweep setup, unchanged material and device judgement.

reach.learn: Include degradation and thermal conditions in design evidence.

evidence.claim: Native spectral parameter sweeps can reduce repeated case setup without establishing actual energy conversion performance.

assumptions: Boundary is an energy-photonic design assignment through an internal version, distinct from the emitting or sensing device in 18197. Manufacturing, installation, field yield and solver runtime earn no saving.

Source records provide spectrum, intensity, incidence, temperature and provenance; material records provide optical properties and conditions. The engineer verifies and captures geometry, material stack and units in s1-s3 and actual evidence in s4. Missing values require manual investigation, not idealised defaults treated as observations.
Native configuration first. Shares are illustrative and unmeasured. Final s4 checking follows complete design and evidence wording; edits void the save gate.
unknowns: Whether native spectral sweeps already cover setup
research_questions: Which case-entry work repeats without changing material assumptions?

already_counted.description: Case review and final conversion-evidence assessment remain in s3-s4.

incremental.description: Maintain spectral case definitions and verify material-library changes.

approvals.approved_version: Final energy-photonic design and evidence checked in s4; edits require rechecking.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Repeated sweep setup saves 9 gross hours less 2 upkeep for 7 net. Existing sweeps or novel modelling give zero benefit. Material choice, physical interpretation and save retain effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Repeated optical cases and history assembly can shrink; fabrication expertise and design accountability remain human.
reach: Coordinate with photonics technicians, quality and materials engineers.
role.ambitious_version: An engineer who keeps each photonic design and its history tied to actual physical and revision evidence.
